record.reason: The primary abstract describes a hierarchical neural architecture with word- and sentence-level attention for document classification, evaluated on six text-classification tasks. It reports task-performance improvements, not an LLM inference/serving system or inference-time efficiency/compression contribution. A general neural NLP architecture alone is outside the stated scope.
record.title: Hierarchical Attention Networks for Document Classification
